headlines.title: Top scientists at OpenAI and Anthropic ask U.S. for tools to pace AI development
headlines.description: More than 1,000 employees at America’s leading AI companies signed a statement asking the U.S. to help support efforts to “pace” cutting-edge AI development.

headlines.title: Nasdaq-100 slides into correction as global chip and memory stocks sell off
headlines.description: Chip stocks around the world sold off sharply, the latest chapter in the monthslong jitters surrounding artificial intelligence, memory and chip stocks.

headlines.title: Federal judge blocks Minnesota’s prediction market ban days before it takes effect
headlines.description: The ruling follows lawsuits from the Justice Department, the Commodity Futures Trading Commission, Polymarket and Kalshi.

headlines.title: New York Gov. Kathy Hochul explains why she signed the first statewide moratorium on data centers
headlines.description: Speaking with NBC News’ “Here’s the Scoop,” Hochul said that she’s responding to the concerns of localities and that New York doesn’t need data centers to support the AI boom.

headlines.title: Watch President Trump's full tribute to Sen. Lindsey Graham
headlines.description: Watch President Trump's full tribute to Sen. Lindsey Graham during the funeral service at Washington National Cathedral. The president recalled their past working together and previous rivalry running against each other in 2016.

headlines.title: Netanyahu joins Trump for high-stakes meeting at the White House
headlines.description: Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu met with President Donald Trump and attended Sen. Lindsey Graham’s funeral.

headlines.title: Company releases video of moth-killing drone aimed at curbing mosquito population
headlines.description: Tech start-up TORNYOL released a video of its "first air-to-air kill" mini-drone and says it could kill mosquitoes "at an unprecedented scale and cost." But experts say swatting the bugs away could be more complicated. NBC News' Marquise Francis reports.

headlines.title: New social media scam uses AI sob stories to target sympathetic buyers
headlines.description: AI scams are on the rise on social media, like a viral story about a bullied teen who crochets handbags he sells online, and experts say it could all be an Al-generated scam. Meanwhile some real creators say their videos are being stolen. NBC News' Vicky Nguyen spoke to experts who share red flags to watch for before hitting that buy button.

headlines.title: Viral video of new robot released by Chinese company raises questions about its abilities
headlines.description: Chinese robotics company Unitree released a new video of its "super athlete" model. It's going viral for its impressive all-terrain capabilities. It's also raising questions about advancements in robotics and how it could be used in the future. NBC News' Priscilla Thompson reports.

headlines.title: Influencer allegedly killed by husband after accusing him of pedophilia on TikTok, police say
headlines.description: A social media influencer was allegedly killed by her estranged husband less than two weeks after she posted on TikTok accusing him of pedophilia, according to police and court records. Sara Gilson was fatally shot Thursday in Oklahoma by husband Jeremiah Duffey, who went by Shawn Duffey on social media, according to the Owasso Police Department. She was 43.

headlines.title: Inside the Growing Backlash Against Expansive AI Data Centers
headlines.description: There is growing backlash against the thousands of AI data centers popping up around the country that require a great deal of land, power and water. It comes as the White House prepares to unveil a plan to curb the skyrocketing power costs associated with the technology’s rapid growth. NBC’s Ryan Nobles reports for TODAY.

headlines.title: What is 'popcorn brain' and how to help it
headlines.description: 'Popcorn brain' is when someone jumps from one task to another, like watching a movie and then scrolling on Instagram, but is different from ADHD. NBC News' Dr. Akshay Syal talks about who may have it and how to treat it.
